properties.short_description: Netflix is a streaming service offering a wide variety of award-winning TV shows, movies, anime, documentaries, and more on internet-connected devices.
Disney+ is a streaming service offering movies, series, and originals from Disney, Marvel, Pixar, Star Wars, and National Geographic.
BuzzFeed is an American internet media company known for news, entertainment, quizzes, and viral content across various lifestyle and pop culture topics.
Spotify is a global audio streaming platform offering music, podcasts, and personalized listening experiences.
HBO Max is a streaming service offering a wide range of TV shows, movies, live sports, and original content from HBO, Discovery, Warner Bros., and more.
Tinder is the world's most popular dating app, enabling people to meet new friends and romantic partners through swiping.
AMC Networks is a media company known for producing and distributing popular television content, including the AMC channel and series like The Walking Dead.
Hulu is an American subscription streaming service offering TV shows, movies, live TV, and original content with ad-supported and ad-free plans.
Rotten Tomatoes is a popular American review-aggregation website for movies and TV shows, known for its Tomatometer rating system.
Just Jared is a multimedia entertainment brand providing celebrity gossip, pop culture news, and entertainment updates through its website and social media platforms.
IMDb is an online database and subscription service providing extensive information on movies, TV shows, and entertainment industry professionals.
The Dodo is a digital media brand focused on animal-related stories and videos, known for heartwarming and relatable content.
YouTube is a global video-sharing platform that enables users to upload, view, and share videos, connecting creators with their communities.
Omaze is a for-profit entertainment company that offers sweepstakes and prize draws to win luxury experiences and prizes while supporting charitable causes.
Now This Booze is a brand focused on cocktails and alcoholic beverages, sharing bold and creative drink recipes and related content.
Billboard is an American music and entertainment brand known for its music charts, news, and awards.
Getty Images is a global visual content creator and marketplace offering a vast collection of high-quality photos, videos, and editorial images, including sports content.
The World Series of Poker Game is an official poker app offering Texas Hold'em and Omaha games, worldwide tournaments, and free poker modes.
Amazon Prime Video is a streaming service offering movies, TV shows, live TV, sports, and Amazon Originals available with a Prime membership.
Rolling Stone is a renowned magazine brand known for music, pop culture, and political journalism.
